h1: Ghana e-Tourist visa from the UK
intro: Ghana's e-Tourist visa lets you apply online for a holiday or a visit to family or friends, without sending your passport away. We complete your eVisa application, check your documents and keep you updated until it's approved.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and a yellow fever certificate

sections.heading: How the Ghana e-Tourist visa works
sections.text: Ghana launched its eVisa system in May 2026. Your application, documents and payment are all sent online, and the approved eVisa is emailed to you. You keep your passport the whole time.

sections.heading: e-Tourist visa or tourist visa?
sections.text: The e-Tourist visa is usually the quicker option. If you'd prefer a visa in your passport, or your case doesn't fit the eVisa, we can apply for a [Ghana tourist visa](/ghana-tourist-visa/) through the High Commission instead.

sections.heading: Yellow fever certificate
sections.text: Ghana requires all arriving travellers to show a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate. Get vaccinated at least 10 days before you travel, at a registered yellow fever centre.

sections.heading: Ghana e-Tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Ghana e-Tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/ghana) for Ghana.

faqs.q: Do I need to send my passport for a Ghana e-Tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Everything is done online. You'll just need a clear scan of your passport photo page.

faqs.q: How long does a Ghana e-Tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Complete applications are often decided within a few working days. Apply at least a couple of weeks before you travel to be safe.

faqs.q: Do I need a yellow fever certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. Ghana requires a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate for entry, and you'll need to upload it with your application.
